notes.gap_definition: 100 * (integer objective cost - instance reference) / instance reference
notes.sd: sample standard deviation; ddof=1; 100 trial values
notes.Ave_row: Each of mean, best, worst, SD is the arithmetic mean of the corresponding four instance-level statistics, not a pooled 400-trial extremum/SD.
notes.LS_source: The completed common initial CSPNS local-search solution is index 3 of the selected TS .res; it is not a timed restart result.
notes.dense_grid: All 224 small/mid fixed-pair training conditions: 4 settings * 4 pairs * 14 alpha values; all reread from raw .res and verified against SHA256.
